title: 6 things your team could stop doing by hand this week

slides.headline: **6 things** your team could stop doing by hand this week
slides.sub: Your team is great. **The busywork isn't.**

slides.label: Client updates
slides.headline: Still answering “Where's my shipment?” **all day?**
slides.pain: Every call pulls someone off real work.
slides.whatif: What if clients got live updates before they even asked?

slides.label: Retyping documents
slides.headline: Typing the same invoice **three times?**
slides.pain: One wrong digit = a penalty or a held shipment.
slides.whatif: What if every document was read once, with mismatches flagged for you?

slides.label: Stock reorders
slides.headline: Out of stock **after** the order is in?
slides.pain: Most stock-outs are spotted too late.
slides.whatif: What if a reorder was drafted the moment stock ran low, ready for your OK?

slides.label: Matching vendor bills
slides.headline: Matching POs, delivery notes and invoices **by hand?**
slides.pain: Pay late, or pay for what never came.
slides.whatif: Imagine all three matched for you, with only real mismatches flagged.

slides.label: Chasing vendors
slides.headline: Chasing vendors on **endless** WhatsApp threads?
slides.pain: When the chaser gets busy, things slip.
slides.whatif: What if follow-ups went out on their own, with every reply in one place?

slides.label: Small approvals
slides.headline: Still approving every **small** purchase yourself?
slides.whatif: What if small spends were approved within your rules, and only big ones came to you?

slides.headline: You've built something that works. What if it worked **even smoother** without you having to lift a finger?
slides.body: That's where **ART (A Realtime Tech)** comes in. Aiotrix's Governed Automation Platform sits on top of the tools you already run and takes all six off your plate. You set the rules.
slides.line: No switching systems. No starting over.

slides.headline: Which one costs **you** the most?
slides.main: Comment the number 👇 or DM us to see where ART fits first.
slides.save: Save this for your next team meeting.
